name: Routewise: Typeform response to signed lead webhook

parameters.content:
## Setup
Same environment variables as the form workflow (`ROUTEWISE_URL`, `ROUTEWISE_TYPEFORM_SECRET` (falls back to `ROUTEWISE_SECRET`), optional `ROUTEWISE_TYPEFORM_SOURCE`, default `typeform`).

In Typeform: Connect > Webhooks > add this workflow's production URL. Give your questions the refs used in the mapping node (`name`, `email`, `phone`, `company`, `job_title`, `country`, `message`, `consent`) or edit them.

If delivery to Routewise fails, this workflow answers 502 so Typeform retries; the response token is used as `external_id`, so the retry cannot create a duplicate lead.
